items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I can get Paul Whiteman or Paul Specht to play that... The same as Paul Specht or Paul Whiteman would do.

ctx.x: Right. Now, was it while you were at the Club Alabam that you started appearing on records, or made the --

Well, I had a chance to make records, but I didn't go, I didn't take it. Because, I went to the Edison Company, I'll never forget that. They sent for us to come down there to make records. This was at the Nest, before I left the Nest. And this fellow, when we started, we started playing one of these numbers like "Covered Wagon" or something like that. And this fellow said, "Look, I can get Paul Whiteman or Paul Specht to play that. What I want you to hear, play me some blues."
